value.rationale: This gives a natural complete equivariant classification of noncover topology of every cycle, not just an Euler characteristic or arbitrary finite calculation. It distinguishes a rank-two dihedral plane from mod-six varying reflection signs and exactly locates rational cohomology survival in natural ordinary symmetry quotients. Previous nonequivariant ranks alone cannot determine this information; the signed-orbit bridge is the structural proof.
